ei.title: 43-45번 — Emma's Journey from Jealousy to Success
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: 43-45번 — Emma's Journey from Jealousy to Success

fullPassage: Emma was a talented vocalist but struggled to gain recognition. Lisa, who went to the same high school with her, had quickly become famous with powerful performances. Emma felt jealous watching Lisa's success. One day, Emma decided to enter a major vocal competition in the capital city. She spent months preparing her masterpiece of a performance, hoping this would finally be her opportunity to shine. When the competition day arrived, Emma felt nervous. Walking into the concert hall, Emma saw a large audience cheering for Lisa. She couldn't help but compare herself to Lisa. On her turn, Emma performed with all her heart, pouring her months of preparation into every note. The judges then evaluated each vocalist's performance carefully. Finally, the results were announced. To her surprise, Emma got first place, not Lisa. Moments later, Lisa came over to congratulate Emma with a warm smile. She said, "Your hard work and dedication really paid off. I'm so happy for you." She didn't seem bothered by the results. "I'm proud that your singing brings joy to people," said Lisa. Emma felt grateful for Lisa's kindness. Lisa added, "I've always been moved by your effort and have been supporting you all along." These words made Emma feel embarrassed at her jealousy. At the same time, she got inspired to find a better path forward. They hugged warmly, their bond strengthened. From that day on, they supported each other and even sang on the same stage together. Emma became more confident and, finally, got a chance to have her solo concert.

questions.passage: Emma was a talented vocalist but struggled to gain recognition. Lisa, who went to the same high school with her, had quickly become famous with powerful performances. Emma felt jealous watching Lisa's success. One day, Emma decided to enter a major vocal competition in the capital city. She spent months preparing her masterpiece of a performance, hoping this would finally be her opportunity to shine. When the competition day arrived, Emma felt nervous. Walking into the concert hall, Emma saw a large audience cheering for Lisa. She couldn't help but compare herself to Lisa. On her turn, Emma performed with all her heart, pouring her months of preparation into every note. The judges then evaluated each vocalist's performance carefully. Finally, the results were announced. To her surprise, Emma got first place, not Lisa. Moments later, Lisa came over to congratulate Emma with a warm smile. She said, "Your hard work and dedication really paid off. I'm so happy for you." She didn't seem bothered by the results. "I'm proud that your singing brings joy to people," said Lisa. Emma felt <u>grateful</u> for Lisa's kindness. Lisa added, "I've always been moved by your effort and have been supporting you all along." These words made Emma feel embarrassed at her jealousy. At the same time, she got inspired to find a better path forward. They hugged warmly, their bond strengthened. From that day on, they supported each other and even sang on the same stage together. Emma became more confident and, finally, got a chance to have her solo concert.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'grateful'과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: grateful(감사하는) ↔ resentful(원망하는)
det.analysis:
✅ ② resentful: 감사하는 ↔ 원망하는
❌ ① thankful(감사하는): 유사어
❌ ③ appreciative(감사하는): 유사어
❌ ④ pleased(기뻐하는): 유사어

questions.passage: (A) She spent months preparing her masterpiece of a performance, hoping this would finally be her opportunity to shine. (B) The morning sun began to shine brightly through the window, filling the room with warm light.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'shine'이 (A)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: shine은 다의어. (A)에서는 '두각을 나타내다/돋보이다'의 비유적 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 두각을 나타내다: 대회에서 빛나고 싶다는 비유적 의미
❌ ① 빛을 반사하다: (B)의 물리적 의미
❌ ② 윤기가 나다: 표면의 물리적 의미
❌ ③ 광을 내다: 물리적 의미

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a feeling of being envious of someone else's advantages or success"

det.korean: jealousy = 다른 사람의 이점이나 성공에 대한 질투심
det.analysis:
✅ ③ jealousy: 타인의 이점/성공을 부러워하는 감정 = 질투
❌ ① gratitude(감사): 다른 의미
❌ ② confidence(자신감): 다른 의미
❌ ④ dedication(헌신): 다른 의미

questions.passage: Emma was a talented vocalist but struggled to gain __________. (recognize) Lisa, who went to the same high school with her, had quickly become famous with powerful performances.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: recognize(동사: 인정하다) → recognition(명사: 인정). gain 뒤에 명사 필요.
det.analysis: 동사 gain 뒤 목적어 → 명사형 → recognize → recognition

questions.passage: Lisa added, "I've always been moved by your effort and have been supporting you all along." These words made Emma feel __________ at her jealousy. (embarrass)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: embarrass(동사: 당혹하게 하다) → embarrassed(형용사: 당혹한). feel 뒤 보어로 과거분사형 형용사 필요.
det.analysis: 지각동사 feel 뒤 보어 → 감정 형용사(과거분사) → embarrass → embarrassed

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: paid off = 보상받다/성과를 거두다. '당신의 노력과 헌신이 보상받았다'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① paid off: 원문 일치 (노력이 보상받다)
❌ ② broke down(고장나다/무너지다): 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ③ gave up(포기하다): 축하 상황에 반대 의미
❌ ④ held back(억제하다): 문맥에 맞지 않음

det.korean: better path forward = 더 나은 길. Lisa의 말에 영감을 받아 '더 나은 길'을 찾게 되었다.

❌ ③ first place(1등): 이미 결과 발표 이후의 문맥
